headline: OpenAI dots brings persistent assistants into everyday work

source.title: OpenAI takes on Meta with dots agent in autonomous AI push

summary: OpenAI introduced dots at its September 29 Developer Day. The product is designed as a persistent assistant that can maintain continuity across tasks and connected applications instead of starting from a blank conversational state each time.
why_it_matters: The product shifts attention from single answers to continuity over time. Users will need clear goals, sensible permissions, and review points when they delegate recurring work.
related_coverage: The enterprise-context story explores the organizational knowledge and permissions that make persistent assistants more useful.
image_alt_intent: Mechanism diagram showing goals, context, connected apps, review points, and ongoing task state around one persistent assistant.
